name: Kou Shamo
source:
He came to Japan twenty years earlier from China.

For various reasons, he keeps trying to push dangerous jobs on Jing. Most of his business is in nightclubs and land speculation.

[i]”I don’t do stuff that doesn’t earn money.”[/i]
